description.zh: 复用 Electron 的无头浏览器：搜索、读取网页、DOM 操作、截图和工作区文件。每位员工使用独立会话；登录须由用户确认。
description.en: Headless browsing with Electron: search, readable pages, DOM actions, screenshots and workspace files. Each employee has an isolated session; saved logins require user confirmation.

mcpServers.name: office-browser
mcpServers.description: Search and browse in a hidden, isolated Electron session. Use browser_snapshot refs for actions; request saved login without seeing credentials.
